description: Deterministic safety rules for major drug-drug interactions validated against the DDInter dataset in data_validation/ddinter_normalized.json. Specific clinical mechanisms, numeric dosing intervals, and management directives are omitted because this repository does not contain validated evidence for those parameters.

rules.evidence_text: DDInter validated major interaction between dolutegravir and aluminum hydroxide (DDInter58 | DDInter582). The source classifies this interaction as Major severity but does not provide clinical mechanism narrative, numeric dosing intervals, or administration timing in this repository; clinical guidance requires external validation. Deterministic safety action is limited to review/hold/monitor; evaluate safer alternative. This is not autonomous prescribing.
